name: M101-DF4 (Hubble)
blurb: M101-DF4, an ultra-diffuse galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: df4-hubble
story: Spotted by the Dragonfly telescope near the spiral galaxy M101, this faint, sprawling galaxy turned out to lie far behind it. Its boomerang-like shape hints that it may be losing stars to tidal stripping.

claims.text: Found with the Dragonfly telescope as an extremely low surface brightness galaxy in the field of M101
DF4-DF7 are not M101 group members but lie in the background NGC 5473/5485 group and are classified as ultra-diffuse galaxies
DF4 has a boomerang-like shape and may be undergoing tidal stripping
